messages:
Arjun: quick sync — BlueWave asked for GA commitments: per-route token billing, 99.95% SLA for inference, and 24/7 emergency support. Need scope + go/no-go.

Mina: what latency targets? models? region?

Arjun: p95 < 150ms for 512 tokens, EU primary with occasional US failover. Models: rwin-v1 family. Steady qps 150, bursts to 800 for 3-6m.

Carlos: Dedicated pinned pools + multi-AZ routing can meet that SLA. Hosted needs reserved burst pools and fallback variants. Fallback sequencing: primary -> quantized -> smaller model.

Priya: commercial: pilot $275k ARR Y1. Sales wants a one-paragraph SLA clause they can include. Legal will need credit calc and caps.

Zoe: ops: require per-route dashboards (p50/p95/p99), SLO burn-rate alerts, and an auto-rollback trigger if p95 > target for >5m. Add sampling for quality checks.

Arjun: docs: onboarding guide + SRE runbook + billing examples. Target 3-4 working days for draft.

Mina: eng estimates: infra + autoscale + routing -> 3w (2 infra), runtime + fallback ->2w (1 runtime), SLA testing + soak ->1w. Parallel docs/legal ->1w. Rough total ~5 weeks.

Carlos: testing plan: lab latency profiling, staging soak, pilot shadowing, guarded cutover. Need sample traces and seq histograms by EOD.

Arjun: options to present to BlueWave: A) Dedicated Pilot: 99.95% SLA, per-route token billing, 24/7 emergency support, faster launch (~5w). B) Hosted Pilot: 99.5% SLA, burst addon, limited support, longer validation (~8w).

Priya: sales: vote A if legal & pricing acceptable. Need contract clause by EOW.

Zoe: ops guardrails: require traffic ramp (48h), approved test harness, and rollback rule (p99 > target for 10m -> failover + page).

Carlos: I'll start infra spike and post initial profiles. Need model versions + payload samples.

Mina: I'll draft the SLA bullets and the per-route billing examples.

Arjun: action owners: Arjun (spec & coordination), Carlos (infra & tests), Mina (monitoring & SLA draft), Priya (sales + contract), Zoe (ops runbook). Ticket created: GA-2201 "BlueWave SLA/pricing pilot" assigned to @Carlos @Mina @Zoe.

Arjun: reconvene in 48 hours. :thumbsup:
